quote: `post_api_request` includes the same identity/runtime fields plus:
# First stream chunk time (epoch s); None if not streamed / no chunk.

semantics_sources.claim: first_chunk_at set from the first counted stream chunk (chat completions and anthropic_messages share _StreamingCall)
codex_responses sets it on the first parsed SSE event

bedrock_converse streams (_BedrockStream, chat_completion_helpers.py:2618, dispatched at :4078-4079) never set it; only two setters exist repo-wide (git grep '_last_api_first_chunk_at\s*=' outside tests)
moa_references = client.last_reference_metrics(), None off the MoA path
entries are slot_metrics(acct, label, output=text) from the most recent fan-out, output privacy-redacted when moa.privacy_filter is set
entry keys: label, model, provider, temperature, usage{input,output,cache_read,cache_write,reasoning tokens}, cost_usd, cost_status, cost_source, output (input_messages popped)
only aggregator usage is returned by the MoA client; advisor spend is folded into session totals separately
maintainer sample payload agrees (first_chunk_at, context_length, moa_references)
